rows.medi_said: أنا بعيد-- er، أنا إمت؟ ... It's بعيد, right? بعيد.
rows.why: He used بعيد for 'remove'; Amal gave إمت (I removed) / بقيم and he said 'بقيم، that's right'. Sheet: 'i remove / take away | Ba2eem | بقيم'.
rows.english: Today I removed (Instagram and games from my phone).

rows.medi_said: Um، دايمًا مش عندي...
rows.why: مش before عند (a have-word that negates with ما); he self-fixed the same phrase later at 03:54 (مش-- ما عندي), she said nothing here.

rows.medi_said: Do you guys use enough كافية? Is, that, is this an Arabic word or no?
rows.why: He asked whether كافية is used for 'enough'; Amal supplied بكفي - a didn't-know.

rows.medi_said: كل اليوم مش-- uh، ما عندي بكافية وقت.
rows.why: Right after she gave بكفي he built a blend بكافية; her reply recasts it as وقت بكفي.
rows.english: Every day I don't have enough time.

rows.medi_said: ما عندي بكافية وقت.
rows.why: He put the 'enough' word before the noun; Amal's recast puts وقت first and بكفي after it.

rows.medi_said: كل اليوم ... ما عندي بكافية وقت.
rows.why: He means 'every day I don't have enough time'; kul + el- means 'all day / the whole day', every day is kul yoam (my reading; she did not react).
rows.english: Every day I don't have enough time.

rows.medi_said: uh، إذا بعيد اللعبة و Instagram.
rows.amal_said: بقيم. حسيت إنه، إنه تغير إشي لما إمت الـ Instagram والـ ألعاب؟
rows.why: Same wrong word for 'remove' again after her 02:38 fix; she said بقيم and he repeated بقيم at 05:08. Sheet: 'i remove / take away | Ba2eem | بقيم'.
rows.english: If I remove the game and Instagram.

rows.medi_said: إذا بعيد اللعبة و Instagram.
rows.amal_said: حسيت إنه تغير إشي لما إمت الـ Instagram والـ ألعاب؟
rows.why: He said singular اللعبة for the games he removed (he had said ألعاب at 02:48); her re-ask uses the plural الـ ألعاب - may be her rephrasing only.

rows.medi_said: تمانية وعشرين ألفين ستة وعشرين.
rows.chat: el-yoam yoam el-arbi3a, tamanya u 3eshreen 3ashara alfain u sitte u 3eshreen
rows.why: He left the month out of the date; Amal prompted '28 شهر؟' and he added عشرة; her chat has the full date.

rows.medi_said: كل إشي بيحر-- بيحرك. بيحرّك.
rows.amal_said: بيت حرك. ... لا، بيت is you getting moved. So كل إشي gets moved.
rows.why: He used the doubled 'move something' form for 'everything is moving'; Amal gave the t- form and explained it, he then said بيتحرك بسرعة.

rows.medi_said: بدك، بدك المطر؟
rows.why: He used 'want' for 'like'; she answered أنا بحب المطر and he took it ('بتحب، yeah'). Sheet: 'like | 7ebb | حب'.

rows.medi_said: فلسطينيين uh، بياخد المطر؟ المي؟
rows.why: Plural subject (Palestinians) with a he-verb; Amal only said كيف يعني (did not understand) and he switched to English.

rows.medi_said: فلسطينيين uh، بياخد المطر؟ المي؟
rows.why: He meant 'collect rainwater' (his English at 09:53); 'take' did not carry it - Amal asked كيف يعني; بيجمعوا is my reading, not hers.

rows.medi_said: أنا جربت بس الـ set، uh, بخرب، uh, بخرب، بخرب-- بخرب؟
rows.why: Present بخرب for something that already broke; Amal gave خربه, he argued, then at 13:48 said خرب and she said 'Yes، خرب'.
rows.english: I tried but the set broke.

rows.medi_said: بنت به. Uh, بنت به ... is to, to take care of something.
rows.amal_said: Actually، بنتبه is more like pay attention.
rows.right: ديري بالك (take care) - بنتبه = pay attention
rows.why: He gave بنتبه as 'take care of'; Amal said it means pay attention, and he moved to ديري بالك for take care.

rows.medi_said: على الأكل في مطبخ
rows.why: After في the known kitchen keeps el-; Amal repeated 'في' and he fixed it to المطبخ; her chat has fi el-matba5.
rows.english: Watch the food in the kitchen.

rows.medi_said: Uh, تمارني. ... أنا نسيت.
rows.amal_said: Mm. What's the other one? ... بتدرب.
rows.why: She asked for the 'practice' verb; he only had the exercise verb and said أنا نسيت, she supplied بتدرب - a didn't-know.

rows.medi_said: Wait, تمارنتي ... I thought it was تمارني.
rows.why: She asked for a command and he gave a past-tense -ti form; she said أمر and gave the -i ending, he said تمرني.

rows.medi_said: بيجيبي إلي ... بيجيبلي إياه
rows.amal_said: جبيلي إياه. Why did you put be؟
rows.why: A command never takes b-; Amal recast جبيلي إياه and asked why he put b-.

rows.medi_said: Trump hadeekna, ... ضحكنا
rows.chat: Trump de7ek 3alaina lamma 7akalna ma fi 7arb deeda
rows.why: 'Fool someone' is ضحك على; he put the object on the verb (ضحكنا), she repeated ضحك twice until he said ضحك علينا.

rows.medi_said: لا حرب جديد. So how do you say no new wars? Is it la or مش؟
rows.amal_said: How about you make there would, there won't be new wars.
rows.chat: Trump de7ek 3alaina lamma 7akalna ma fi 7arb deeda
rows.why: He negated a noun with لا; Amal steered him to 'there won't be' and he said ما في (her chat: ma fi 7arb).

rows.medi_said: harb jadeed. Jadeeda.
rows.amal_said: جدد. We didn't learn the plural for حرب. ... حروب.
rows.why: He meant 'wars' but had only the singular; Amal said they had not learned the plural and taught حروب - a didn't-know. (His جديد -> جديدة was his own self-fix.)

rows.medi_said: it's, إسّافري؟ ... so سـ، uh, سفّري
rows.amal_said: But what's, what's smack in the middle of it? ... سافري. ... You should say سافري.
rows.chat: saafri 3ala hadik el-dawle iza biddek jbaal
rows.why: A long-vowel verb takes no إ- in the command; Amal prompted the long A and recast سافري, he took it at 39:57.

rows.medi_said: uh, إذا بدك جبال
rows.amal_said: الجبال. ... جبال. جبال. جبل. جبل is one.
rows.chat: saafri 3ala hadik el-dawle iza biddek jbaal
rows.why: He asked 'What did I say?' and then 'So jabal, jibal. It's plural' - Amal's fix is the plural jbaal vs one jabal; engine wrote جبال, he likely said the singular/a wrong vowel.

rows.medi_said: Surprise. It's, uh, I don't know how to say surprise.
rows.why: He said he did not know 'surprise'; Amal supplied مفاجأة - a didn't-know.

rows.medi_said: روحي بيت روحي من بيت no روحي بيت
rows.amal_said: If I want to say the beit, I would have to say to the home. So what's the to part? ... Ala el beit.
rows.why: He put بيت straight after the verb; Amal said to name the home it needs 'to' (على) and el-: rawahi ala el beit.

rows.medi_said: الراوي هون ... الراوي على هون
rows.amal_said: it's a wrong form. ... Right verb, but wrong command form. ... it's a double W. So rawahi.
rows.why: Engine wrote الراوي; Amal said 'right verb, but wrong command form' and gave rawwi7i, he then said روحي هون.

rows.medi_said: Because you forgot your keys, so ashan nisti ma-- uh...
rows.amal_said: Mm. So you forgot. ... It's one of the irregulars. ... Nseeti
rows.why: Wrong you-fem past of نسي; Amal said it is irregular and gave nseeti, he said نسيتي at 47:55.

rows.medi_said: لا تسعة، لا، no تسعة. ... Would I say تسعة؟ على تسعة؟
rows.why: Clock time takes el-; he said تسعة, then asked, and Amal recast على التسع - partly a question, so medium.

rows.medi_said: Uh, خافي خافي
rows.why: She asked 'scare me' and he gave the get-scared form; Amal said No and he moved to the doubled make-scared خوّفني.

rows.medi_said: خوّف خوفني
rows.amal_said: بلاش. خوفني، yes. مش إي. Did you put an إي؟
rows.why: He put an إ- on a doubled-letter command; Amal asked 'Did you put an إي؟', he said 'I did' and repeated خوّفني without it (engine dropped the إ).

rows.medi_said: imta barawe min safar, um, when are you gonna leave from your trip?
rows.amal_said: Gonna come back from your trip.
rows.why: Translating her sentence he read رَوّح as 'leave'; she said it means come back.
rows.english: When did you come back from the trip?

rows.medi_said: أي ساعة راح ترجع من، أنا، أنا برجع، uh, to the gym, right?
rows.why: He heard her ترجع من as 'to'; she repeated من الgym and he said 'Oh, you said من؟ أنا برجع من الجيم'.
rows.english: What time will you come back from the gym?
